core_obligations: Construct the compatible quasi-Hamiltonian form on the surface moduli space.
Establish moment-map and degeneracy identities with boundary holonomy.
Identify fixed points with the twisted representation space via monodromy.
difficulty_reason: The proof descends the corrected two-form from a moduli space of flat connections and proves its minimal-degeneracy condition by a boundary gauge-field and holonomy argument. It then identifies the finite-group fixed points with representations twisted by the quotient group-bundle monodromy. The required loop-group formulae, compatibility construction, fixed-point argument and smoothness appendix are retained as one source-local chain.
